desc: Analyze single-person constraints: A_S = A_T, interior above A_S if S<T (sign +), below if S>T (sign -).

Adopt pairwise compatibility rules: conflict iff same left endpoint, same right endpoint, or same-sign proper crossing; confirmed by exhaustive N=3,4,5 and 3000 random subset tests vs exact reference.
Implement per-sign O(M log N) sweep (two segment trees with heaps at leaves) to compute nextA/nextB, plus dictionaries for next same-L/same-R, combine into next_conflict.
Build range-min segment tree over next_conflict; answer each query [L,R] as No iff min_{i in [L,R]} next_conflict[i] <= R.
Produce the final standalone stdin/stdout program implementing the sweep + range-min queries and verify it against BOTH provided samples (passed).
